subject: mirtCAT: External html files generated from rmarkdown do not work

messages.author: 23af263897ab25cd
messages.subject: mirtCAT: External html files generated from rmarkdown do not work
parts:
Pro.Chalmers,

The demo html file can be rendered to be an item. However, the html file generated by rmarkdown fails to be rendered, and the mirtCAT does not proceed to the html item. For example, if the html file is the third item, mirtCAT stop at second item, and can't proceed to the third item.

FYI, on the other hand, the md file generated by rmarkdown works as an external item as advertised.

I would like to use html file for external items. Would you let me know whether there are any specific rmarkdown rendering option for html the mirtCAT can read? 

Best,
Dongjun

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT: External html files generated from rmarkdown do not work
parts:
I can't offer much advice without a reproducible example first, but if you are noticing that you can compile the .md file to a suitable .html then you can instead point to that since mirtCAT recognizes HTML files directly as stems. You'll have to manually compile your markdown files each time you make changes, but that can of course be automated via R scripts. HTH.

Phil
